H03-01: Inspection of controls attributes on <video> and <audio> elements.
Pass: Non-decorative media elements have the controls attribute.
Fail: Media elements lack controls (and especially if autoplay is active).
2. Skip decorative background videos (autoplay + muted + loop) or aria-hidden media.
3. Check for the controls attribute. Flag if missing.
4. Escalate issue if autoplay is present without controls.
If a <video> lacks the controls attribute:
- Add the controls attribute to enable native play, pause, and volume options.
If a <video> uses autoplay without controls:
- Add the controls attribute immediately, as autoplay media without controls prevents users from stopping it.
If an <audio> lacks the controls attribute:
- Add the controls attribute to allow users to manage audio playback.
If an <audio> uses autoplay without controls:
- Add the controls attribute so users are not forced to listen to audio they cannot stop.
